title: LLM-generated Java and Python formative quiz bank
summary: Instructors prompt four language models to create multiple-choice and fill-in-the-blank questions for introductory and intermediate Java and Python topics. The proposed formative quiz bank requires educator review for accuracy, relevance, clarity, and educational value before students receive any questions.

sources.title: From GPT to BERT: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Automated Quiz Generation
sources.evidence_quote: Each model was asked to generate 200 unique questions for Java and Python, totaling 800 questions per programming language designed to test a range of cognitive skills.

assessment.summary: Answer educator-approved Java and Python questions generated from a topic, difficulty level, and requested item format.
student_actions: Answer multiple-choice or fill-in-the-blank programming questions.

student_role.description: GPT-3, GPT-4, GPT-4o, and BERT generate candidate items for educator review; the paper does not give students an AI role.
